senses.label: hospital room
senses.definitionEn: a large room or section in a hospital where patients with similar needs stay

examples.en: My grandfather was moved to a different ward last night.
examples.tr: Dedem dün gece farklı bir koğuşa taşındı.

examples.en: The nurses on the children's ward are always very kind.
examples.tr: Çocuk servisindeki hemşireler her zaman çok nazik.

examples.en: Visitors may enter the ward only between two and four.
examples.tr: Ziyaretçiler koğuşa yalnızca saat iki ile dört arasında girebilir.

commonMistakesTr: 'warm' ılık/sıcak demektir; çok sıcak için 'hot' kullanılır: It's hot today (bugün çok sıcak).

senses.label: slightly hot
senses.definitionEn: having a pleasant temperature that is not cold but not too hot

examples.en: Put on a warm coat before you go outside.
examples.tr: Dışarı çıkmadan önce kalın bir mont giy.
examples.noteTr: warm coat: kalın, sıcak tutan mont.

examples.en: The water in the sea is warm in August.
Is your room warm enough at night?

senses.label: friendly
senses.definitionEn: friendly and kind in a way that makes people feel comfortable

examples.en: Her family gave me a really warm welcome.
He has a warm smile that everyone likes.
examples.tr: Herkesin sevdiği sıcak bir gülümsemesi var.

grammarNoteTr: Sayılamaz isimdir: a warmth değil, warmth.

senses.label: heat or friendliness
senses.definitionEn: a pleasant feeling of being not cold, or a kind and friendly quality

examples.en: We sat by the fire and enjoyed its warmth.
examples.tr: Ateşin yanında oturup sıcaklığının tadını çıkardık.

examples.en: The warmth of the people made the trip special.
Thick socks keep the warmth in your feet.

commonMistakesTr: 'Yıkanmak' için 'wash myself' yerine genelde 'have a wash' veya 'take a shower' denir.

senses.label: clean with water
senses.definitionEn: to clean something or someone using water and usually soap

examples.en: Always wash your hands before you eat.
examples.tr: Yemekten önce her zaman ellerini yıka.
examples.noteTr: Emir kipi: fiil yalın hâlde başta.

examples.en: I washed my car on Sunday morning.
Who is going to wash the dishes tonight?

collocations: put clothes in the washing machine

senses.label: machine for clothes
senses.definitionEn: an electric machine that cleans clothes

examples.en: Our washing machine broke, so I washed everything by hand.
examples.tr: Çamaşır makinemiz bozuldu, ben de her şeyi elde yıkadım.

examples.en: Don't put that wool sweater in the washing machine.
examples.tr: O yün kazağı çamaşır makinesine koyma.

examples.en: The new flat comes with a fridge and a washing machine.
examples.tr: Yeni dairede buzdolabı ve çamaşır makinesi var.

senses.label: using too much
senses.definitionEn: using more of something than is needed, so that some is lost or thrown away

examples.en: Leaving the lights on all day is very wasteful.
examples.tr: Işıkları bütün gün açık bırakmak çok savurganca.

examples.en: The report criticised the wasteful use of public money.
examples.tr: Rapor kamu parasının israf edilmesini eleştirdi.

examples.en: We are trying to be less wasteful with food at home.
examples.tr: Evde yiyecek konusunda daha az savurgan olmaya çalışıyoruz.

grammarNoteTr: -proof eki '-e dayanıklı' anlamı verir: soundproof, bulletproof.

senses.label: not letting water in
senses.definitionEn: made so that water cannot get through it

examples.en: Take a waterproof jacket because it might rain.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağabilir, su geçirmez bir ceket al.

examples.en: My phone is waterproof, so it survived the fall into the pool.
examples.tr: Telefonum su geçirmez, bu yüzden havuza düşünce bozulmadı.

examples.en: These boots are not fully waterproof.
examples.tr: Bu botlar tamamen su geçirmez değil.

grammarNoteTr: wave at/to someone: birine el sallamak

senses.label: move your hand
senses.definitionEn: to move your hand from side to side to say hello or goodbye

examples.en: The children waved at us from the bus window.
examples.tr: Çocuklar otobüs penceresinden bize el salladı.

examples.en: She turned and waved goodbye before she left.
examples.tr: Gitmeden önce dönüp hoşça kal diye el salladı.

examples.en: Why is that man waving at me?
examples.tr: O adam neden bana el sallıyor?

senses.label: moving water
senses.definitionEn: a raised line of water that moves across the sea (noun)

examples.en: The waves were too big for swimming today.
examples.tr: Bugün dalgalar yüzmek için fazla büyüktü.

examples.en: We sat on the beach and listened to the waves.

grammarNoteTr: have a weakness for: -e zaafı olmak

senses.label: lack of strength / fault
senses.definitionEn: the state of not being strong, or a part of something or someone that is not good enough

examples.en: Every candidate should know their strengths and weaknesses.
examples.tr: Her aday güçlü ve zayıf yönlerini bilmeli.
examples.noteTr: strengths and weaknesses: güçlü ve zayıf yönler.

examples.en: I have a weakness for chocolate cake.
After the illness she felt weakness in her legs.

grammarNoteTr: a wealth of + isim: bol miktarda, zengin bir ...

senses.label: money and property
senses.definitionEn: a large amount of money or valuable things that someone owns

examples.en: He made his wealth by selling software.
Wealth does not always bring happiness.
The museum has a wealth of information about local history.
examples.tr: Müzede yerel tarih hakkında zengin bilgi var.

senses.label: rich
senses.definitionEn: having a lot of money or valuable things

examples.en: She comes from a wealthy family in the north.
Wealthy countries should help poorer ones.
examples.tr: Zengin ülkeler daha yoksul olanlara yardım etmeli.

examples.en: The area became wealthy after the port opened.

senses.label: thing used to fight
senses.definitionEn: an object such as a gun or knife that is used to hurt people or in fighting

examples.en: Visitors may not bring weapons into the building.
The police found the weapon near the river.
Humour can be a powerful weapon in difficult situations.
examples.tr: Mizah zor durumlarda güçlü bir silah olabilir.

commonMistakesTr: 'Giymek' eylemi için 'put on', giyili olma hâli için 'wear' kullanılır: She is wearing a hat (şapka takıyor).

senses.label: have on your body
senses.definitionEn: to have clothes, shoes, glasses or jewellery on your body

examples.en: She always wears a red scarf in winter.
examples.tr: Kışın her zaman kırmızı bir atkı takar.

examples.en: Do you have to wear a uniform at work?
I wore my best shoes to the interview.

senses.label: the internet
senses.definitionEn: the system of connected pages and information on the internet

examples.en: I found the recipe on the web.
Our company is building a new web page for customers.
examples.tr: Şirketimiz müşteriler için yeni bir web sayfası hazırlıyor.

examples.en: Can you search the web for cheap flights?

senses.label: spider's net
senses.definitionEn: a net of thin threads made by a spider

examples.en: There is a big spider's web in the corner of the garage.
examples.tr: Garajın köşesinde büyük bir örümcek ağı var.

examples.en: A fly got stuck in the web.

senses.label: marriage ceremony
senses.definitionEn: a ceremony and party when two people get married

examples.en: We are going to my cousin's wedding next month.
The wedding took place in a small garden.
She showed us photos of her wedding dress.

commonMistakesTr: Gün isimleri İngilizcede büyük harfle yazılır: Wednesday (wednesday değil).

senses.label: day of the week
senses.definitionEn: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

examples.en: The meeting is on Wednesday at ten.
I go swimming every Wednesday evening.
Is the shop open on Wednesday afternoons?
examples.tr: Dükkân çarşamba öğleden sonraları açık mı?

senses.label: Monday to Friday
senses.definitionEn: any day from Monday to Friday

examples.en: The library closes at eight on weekdays.
examples.tr: Kütüphane hafta içi saat sekizde kapanır.

examples.en: Trains are more crowded on weekday mornings.
examples.tr: Trenler hafta içi sabahları daha kalabalık.

examples.en: I never cook a big dinner on a weekday.
examples.tr: Hafta içi hiç büyük bir akşam yemeği pişirmem.

commonMistakesTr: 'Hafta sonunda' için İng. 'at the weekend', ABD 'on the weekend'; 'in the weekend' yaygın değildir.

senses.label: Saturday and Sunday
senses.definitionEn: Saturday and Sunday, when many people do not work

examples.en: What are you doing at the weekend?
We spent the weekend at my parents' house.
Have a nice weekend, see you on Monday!

grammarNoteTr: Hem sıfat (weekly meeting) hem zarf (paid weekly) olarak kullanılır.

senses.label: every week
senses.definitionEn: happening or done once every week

examples.en: We have a weekly team meeting on Mondays.
I do my weekly shopping on Saturday mornings.
The magazine is published weekly.

commonMistakesTr: 'Kilom 70' demek için 'I weigh 70 kilos' denir; 'My weight is 70' daha az doğaldır.

senses.label: have a weight / measure weight
senses.definitionEn: to have a particular heaviness, or to measure how heavy something is

examples.en: The suitcase weighs more than twenty kilos.
The nurse weighed the baby every week.
How much does your dog weigh?

commonMistakesTr: 'Kilo vermek' için 'lose weight', 'kilo almak' için 'put on/gain weight' denir; 'give/take weight' yanlıştır.

senses.label: how heavy
senses.definitionEn: how heavy someone or something is

examples.en: He lost a lot of weight after he started cycling.
examples.tr: Bisiklete binmeye başladıktan sonra çok kilo verdi.

examples.en: The weight of the box surprised me.
She lifts weights at the gym three times a week.
examples.tr: Spor salonunda haftada üç kez ağırlık kaldırıyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'Rica ederim' için 'You're welcome' denir; 'Welcome' tek başına 'hoş geldin' anlamındadır.
grammarNoteTr: welcome to + yer: Welcome to Istanbul!

senses.label: greet / be glad
senses.definitionEn: to greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive, or to be glad to accept something

examples.en: Our hosts welcomed us with tea and cake.
examples.tr: Ev sahiplerimiz bizi çay ve kekle karşıladı.

examples.en: Welcome to our new office!
The company welcomes ideas from all its staff.
examples.tr: Şirket tüm çalışanlarından gelen fikirleri memnuniyetle karşılar.

grammarNoteTr: well-known for: ... ile tanınan; isimden sonra gelince tire düşebilir: The place is well known.

senses.label: known by many
senses.definitionEn: known about by a lot of people

examples.en: The town is well-known for its olive oil.
A well-known chef opened a restaurant on our street.
examples.tr: Tanınmış bir şef sokağımızda restoran açtı.

examples.en: It is a well-known fact that sleep helps memory.
examples.tr: Uykunun belleğe yardım ettiği bilinen bir gerçektir.

grammarNoteTr: Yön isimleri genelde 'the' ile: in the west

senses.label: direction
senses.definitionEn: the direction where the sun goes down in the evening

examples.en: The sun sets in the west.
They live in a small village to the west of the city.
examples.tr: Şehrin batısındaki küçük bir köyde yaşıyorlar.

examples.en: We drove west for three hours.

grammarNoteTr: Bölge adlarında büyük harfle: Western Europe

senses.label: of the west
senses.definitionEn: in or from the west of a place, or connected with Europe and North America

examples.en: Izmir is on the western coast of Turkey.
The film shows the influence of Western music.
Rain is expected in the western parts of the country.

senses.label: covered with water
senses.definitionEn: covered with water or another liquid; not dry

examples.en: Take an umbrella or you will get wet.
Don't sit there, the bench is still wet.
It was a cold, wet day in November.

senses.label: anything / no matter what
senses.definitionEn: anything at all, or it does not matter what

examples.en: You can order whatever you like from the menu.
Whatever happens, I will support you.
Wear whatever is comfortable for the trip.
examples.tr: Yolculuk için rahat olan ne varsa onu giy.

senses.label: round part
senses.definitionEn: a round object that turns to help a vehicle move

examples.en: My bike has a flat back wheel.
He kept both hands on the steering wheel.
Suitcases with wheels are much easier to carry.
examples.tr: Tekerlekli bavulları taşımak çok daha kolay.

senses.label: every time / any time
senses.definitionEn: every time that something happens, or at any time

examples.en: Whenever I visit my aunt, she makes börek.
examples.tr: Teyzemi ne zaman ziyaret etsem börek yapar.

examples.en: Call me whenever you need help.
We try to walk to work whenever possible.
examples.tr: Mümkün olduğunca işe yürüyerek gitmeye çalışıyoruz.

senses.label: any place
senses.definitionEn: in or to any place, or it does not matter where

examples.en: My dog follows me wherever I go.
Feel free to sit wherever you like.
Wherever you live, you can learn online.

grammarNoteTr: 'while' ile aynı anlam; daha resmî ve İngiliz İngilizcesi.

senses.label: while
senses.definitionEn: during the time that; or used to show a contrast (formal, British)

examples.en: Please do not use your phone whilst driving.
He read a magazine whilst he waited for the doctor.
Some students prefer exams, whilst others prefer projects.
examples.tr: Bazı öğrenciler sınavları tercih ederken diğerleri projeleri tercih ediyor.

senses.label: speak quietly
senses.definitionEn: to speak very quietly using your breath and not your voice

examples.en: She whispered the answer to her friend.
Why are you whispering? Nobody else is here.
examples.tr: Neden fısıldıyorsun? Burada başka kimse yok.

examples.en: We had to whisper because the baby was asleep.
examples.tr: Bebek uyuduğu için fısıldamak zorunda kaldık.

senses.label: any person who
senses.definitionEn: any person who; or the person who, when you do not know who it is

examples.en: Whoever finishes first can go home early.
examples.tr: Kim önce bitirirse erken eve gidebilir.

examples.en: Whoever took my pen, please give it back.
examples.tr: Kalemimi kim aldıysa lütfen geri versin.

examples.en: You can invite whoever you want to the party.

commonMistakesTr: 'Bütün gün' için 'the whole day' veya 'all day' denir; 'all the whole day' yanlıştır.
grammarNoteTr: the whole + tekil isim: the whole class

senses.label: complete
senses.definitionEn: all of something; complete

examples.en: I spent the whole day cleaning the house.
The whole class laughed at his joke.
She ate a whole pizza by herself.
examples.tr: Koca bir pizzayı tek başına yedi.

grammarNoteTr: Resmî dil; günlük konuşmada 'completely' daha yaygın.

senses.label: completely
senses.definitionEn: completely; in every way (formal)

examples.en: The company is wholly owned by the family.
I am not wholly convinced by his explanation.
examples.tr: Onun açıklamasına tamamen ikna olmuş değilim.

examples.en: The project was wholly paid for by local donations.
examples.tr: Proje bütünüyle yerel bağışlarla finanse edildi.

commonMistakesTr: Edattan sonra 'who' değil 'whom' kullanılır: to whom (to who değil).
grammarNoteTr: Nesne konumundaki 'who'nun resmî biçimi; edattan sonra zorunlu.

senses.label: object form of who
senses.definitionEn: used instead of 'who' as the object of a verb or after a preposition

examples.en: To whom should I send the application?
The woman with whom I work is from Canada.
He has two brothers, both of whom are teachers.
examples.tr: İki erkek kardeşi var, ikisi de öğretmen.

senses.label: belonging to whom
senses.definitionEn: used to ask or say who something belongs to

examples.en: Whose keys are these on the table?
I met a man whose son plays football for the city.
examples.tr: Oğlu şehir takımında futbol oynayan bir adamla tanıştım.

examples.en: Whose turn is it to wash up?

senses.label: large from side to side
senses.definitionEn: measuring a large distance from one side to the other

examples.en: The river is very wide near the sea.
examples.tr: Nehir denize yakın yerde çok geniş.

examples.en: The shop sells a wide range of teas.
examples.noteTr: a wide range of: çok çeşitli.

examples.en: The door is only seventy centimetres wide.

senses.label: by many people / in many places
senses.definitionEn: by a lot of people or in a lot of places

examples.en: English is widely used in international business.
examples.tr: İngilizce uluslararası iş dünyasında yaygın olarak kullanılır.

examples.en: It is widely believed that the bridge is very old.
examples.tr: Köprünün çok eski olduğuna yaygın olarak inanılır.

examples.en: She has travelled widely in Asia.

senses.label: happening in many places
senses.definitionEn: existing or happening in many places or among many people

examples.en: The storm caused widespread damage along the coast.
examples.tr: Fırtına kıyı boyunca geniş çaplı hasara yol açtı.

examples.en: There is widespread support for the new park.
examples.tr: Yeni park için yaygın bir destek var.

examples.en: Smartphones became widespread in the early 2010s.

senses.label: married woman
senses.definitionEn: the woman that a man is married to

examples.en: This is my wife, Elif.
He and his wife run a small café.
examples.tr: O ve eşi küçük bir kafe işletiyor.

examples.en: The two men brought their wives to the dinner.

senses.label: living in nature
senses.definitionEn: living or growing in nature, not kept or grown by people

examples.en: We saw wild horses in the mountains.
Wild flowers cover the hills in spring.
These birds are rarely seen in the wild.
examples.tr: Bu kuşlar doğal ortamlarında nadiren görülür.

senses.label: animals in nature
senses.definitionEn: animals and plants that live in natural conditions

examples.en: The lake is home to a lot of wildlife.
examples.tr: Göl pek çok yaban hayvanına ev sahipliği yapıyor.
examples.noteTr: be home to: -e ev sahipliği yapmak.

examples.en: Plastic in the sea is a danger to wildlife.
examples.tr: Denizdeki plastik yaban hayatı için tehlike oluşturuyor.

examples.en: We watched a wildlife documentary last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece bir doğa belgeseli izledik.

senses.label: happily / by choice
senses.definitionEn: in a way that shows you are happy to do something without being forced

examples.en: She willingly gave up her seat for the old man.
examples.tr: Yaşlı adam için yerini seve seve verdi.
examples.noteTr: give up a seat: yer vermek.

examples.en: Nobody willingly pays more tax.
examples.tr: Kimse isteyerek daha fazla vergi ödemez.

examples.en: The staff willingly worked late before the opening.
examples.tr: Çalışanlar açılıştan önce gönüllü olarak geç saate kadar çalıştı.

senses.label: being ready to do something
senses.definitionEn: the quality of being ready and happy to do something

examples.en: We were impressed by his willingness to learn.
Both sides showed a willingness to talk.
examples.tr: Her iki taraf da konuşmaya istekli olduğunu gösterdi.

examples.en: Her willingness to help made her popular with neighbours.
examples.tr: Yardım etmeye hazır olması onu komşuları arasında sevilen biri yaptı.

senses.label: person who wins
senses.definitionEn: a person, team or animal that wins a game, competition or prize

examples.en: The winner of the race gets a gold medal.
They will announce the winners on Friday.
Who was the winner of last year's competition?

senses.label: that wins
senses.definitionEn: that wins or has won a competition

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute.
examples.noteTr: the winning goal: maçı kazandıran gol.

examples.en: The winning team celebrated in the main square.
examples.tr: Kazanan takım ana meydanda kutlama yaptı.

examples.en: Check the winning numbers in tomorrow's paper.
examples.tr: Kazanan numaraları yarınki gazetede kontrol et.

senses.label: cold season
senses.definitionEn: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring

examples.en: It often snows here in winter.
examples.tr: Burada kışın sık sık kar yağar.

examples.en: We went skiing last winter.
Do you have any winter boots?

senses.label: thin metal thread
senses.definitionEn: a long thin piece of metal used to carry electricity or to hold things

examples.en: Don't touch that wire, it might be live.
He fixed the fence with a piece of wire.
There are too many wires behind my desk.
examples.tr: Masamın arkasında çok fazla kablo var.

senses.label: without wires
senses.definitionEn: using radio signals instead of wires

examples.en: The hotel has free wireless internet in every room.
examples.tr: Otelin her odasında ücretsiz kablosuz internet var.

examples.en: I bought wireless headphones for running.
Is the printer connected to the wireless network?

grammarNoteTr: Sayılamaz isim; wisdom tooth: yirmilik dişi

senses.label: good judgement
senses.definitionEn: the ability to make good decisions based on knowledge and experience

examples.en: My grandmother's wisdom helped me through hard times.
examples.tr: Büyükannemin bilgeliği zor zamanlarımda bana yardımcı oldu.

examples.en: Wisdom often comes with age and experience.
examples.tr: Bilgelik çoğu zaman yaş ve tecrübeyle gelir.

examples.en: I questioned the wisdom of buying such an expensive car.
examples.tr: Bu kadar pahalı bir araba almanın akıllıca olup olmadığını sorguladım.
examples.noteTr: the wisdom of + -ing: ... yapmanın akıllıca olması.

grammarNoteTr: it is wise to + fiil: ... yapmak akıllıcadır

senses.label: showing good judgement
senses.definitionEn: able to make good decisions because of knowledge and experience

examples.en: It would be wise to book the tickets early.
examples.noteTr: it would be wise to: ... akıllıca olur.

examples.en: My teacher was a wise and patient woman.
examples.tr: Öğretmenim bilge ve sabırlı bir kadındı.

examples.en: Moving to a smaller flat was a wise decision.
examples.tr: Daha küçük bir daireye taşınmak akıllıca bir karardı.

grammarNoteTr: Fiil olarak da kullanılır: witness an accident (bir kazaya tanık olmak).

senses.label: person who sees an event
senses.definitionEn: a person who sees something happen, especially a crime or accident

examples.en: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident.
The witness described the car in detail.
examples.tr: Tanık arabayı ayrıntılı bir şekilde tarif etti.

examples.en: She was the only witness who saw the man's face.
examples.tr: Adamın yüzünü gören tek tanık oydu.

senses.label: very good
senses.definitionEn: extremely good or pleasant

examples.en: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
examples.noteTr: have a wonderful time: harika vakit geçirmek.

examples.en: What wonderful news about your new job!
examples.tr: Yeni işinle ilgili ne harika bir haber!

examples.en: The view from the top of the hill is wonderful.

commonMistakesTr: 'Odun/tahta' anlamında sayılamaz: some wood. 'Woods' çoğulu 'koru, orman' anlamına gelir.

senses.label: material from trees
senses.definitionEn: the hard material that trees are made of

examples.en: The table is made of old wood.
We collected wood for the fire.
This kind of wood is very light and strong.
examples.tr: Bu tür tahta çok hafif ve sağlam.

senses.label: small forest
senses.definitionEn: an area of land covered with trees, smaller than a forest

examples.en: We went for a walk in the woods.
There is a small wood behind the school.
examples.tr: Okulun arkasında küçük bir koru var.

senses.label: made of wood
senses.definitionEn: made of wood

examples.en: The children played with wooden toys.
We sat on a wooden bench in the park.
Old houses in this street have wooden floors.
examples.tr: Bu sokaktaki eski evlerin ahşap zeminleri var.

senses.label: person who works
senses.definitionEn: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of job

examples.en: The factory employs over five hundred workers.
examples.tr: Fabrika beş yüzden fazla işçi çalıştırıyor.

examples.en: She is a very hard worker.
Health workers did an amazing job during the crisis.
examples.tr: Sağlık çalışanları kriz sırasında harika bir iş çıkardı.

senses.label: related to work
senses.definitionEn: related to work or a job, or having a job

examples.en: My working hours are from nine to five.
The workers asked for better working conditions.
examples.tr: İşçiler daha iyi çalışma koşulları istedi.

examples.en: Many working parents need help with childcare.
examples.tr: Çalışan birçok ebeveynin çocuk bakımı konusunda yardıma ihtiyacı var.

grammarNoteTr: Fiil hâli ayrı yazılır: work out (spor yapmak).

senses.label: period of exercise
senses.definitionEn: a period of physical exercise

examples.en: I do a short workout every morning.
examples.tr: Her sabah kısa bir antrenman yaparım.

examples.en: That workout was really hard!
She follows online workouts at home.

senses.label: place where people work
senses.definitionEn: the office, factory or other place where people work

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed in the workplace.
A friendly workplace makes people more productive.
examples.tr: Samimi bir iş yeri insanları daha verimli yapar.

examples.en: The company wants to create a safer workplace.
examples.tr: Şirket daha güvenli bir iş yeri oluşturmak istiyor.

senses.label: training session
senses.definitionEn: a meeting where people learn about a subject by discussing it and doing activities

examples.en: I attended a photography workshop at the weekend.
examples.tr: Hafta sonu bir fotoğrafçılık atölyesine katıldım.

examples.en: Our team will run a workshop for new staff.
examples.tr: Ekibimiz yeni çalışanlar için bir atölye çalışması düzenleyecek.

examples.en: The museum offers free art workshops for children.
examples.tr: Müze çocuklar için ücretsiz sanat atölyeleri sunuyor.

senses.label: room for making things
senses.definitionEn: a room or building where things are made or repaired

examples.en: My father spends hours in his workshop fixing old radios.
examples.tr: Babam atölyesinde eski radyoları tamir ederek saatler geçirir.

examples.en: The car is still at the workshop.

grammarNoteTr: Sıfat olarak da kullanılır: a worldwide problem

senses.label: all over the world
senses.definitionEn: in or across all parts of the world

examples.en: The book has sold two million copies worldwide.
examples.tr: Kitap dünya çapında iki milyon kopya sattı.

examples.en: Climate change is a worldwide problem.
examples.tr: İklim değişikliği dünya çapında bir sorundur.

examples.en: Do you offer free shipping worldwide?
examples.tr: Dünyanın her yerine ücretsiz gönderim yapıyor musunuz?

commonMistakesTr: 'Bad' kelimesinin karşılaştırma hâli 'worse'tür; 'more bad' veya 'badder' yanlıştır.

senses.label: more bad
senses.definitionEn: less good or more unpleasant than something else

examples.en: The traffic is worse than it was yesterday.
My cold got worse during the night.
Could the weather get any worse?
examples.tr: Hava bundan daha kötü olabilir mi?

grammarNoteTr: Resmî; günlük dilde 'get worse' daha yaygın.

senses.label: become worse
senses.definitionEn: to become worse or make something worse

examples.en: The situation worsened after the heavy rain.
Stress can worsen sleep problems.
Relations between the two companies have worsened.

grammarNoteTr: İsim olarak: a place of worship (ibadet yeri)

senses.label: show respect to a god
senses.definitionEn: to show respect and love for a god, for example by praying

examples.en: People have worshipped in this old building for centuries.
examples.tr: İnsanlar yüzyıllardır bu eski binada ibadet ediyor.
examples.noteTr: Present perfect: geçmişten bugüne süren durum.

examples.en: Ancient people worshipped the sun.
The town has several places of worship.

senses.label: most bad
senses.definitionEn: worse than all others

examples.en: That was the worst film I have ever seen.
examples.noteTr: the worst ... ever: şimdiye kadarki en kötü.

examples.en: Monday is the worst day of the week for me.
examples.tr: Benim için haftanın en kötü günü pazartesi.

examples.en: The worst part of the trip was the long flight.
examples.tr: Yolculuğun en kötü kısmı uzun uçuştu.

senses.label: worth the time or effort
senses.definitionEn: useful or enjoyable enough to be worth the time, money or effort

examples.en: Volunteering at the shelter was a worthwhile experience.
examples.tr: Barınakta gönüllü çalışmak değerli bir deneyimdi.

examples.en: Is it worthwhile to repair this old laptop?
examples.tr: Bu eski dizüstü bilgisayarı tamir ettirmeye değer mi?
examples.noteTr: Is it worthwhile to ...: -e değer mi?

examples.en: All the hard work was worthwhile in the end.
examples.tr: Sonunda tüm o sıkı çalışma buna değdi.

commonMistakesTr: 'Yara' anlamında /wuːnd/ okunur; 'wind' fiilinin geçmişi olan 'wound' /waʊnd/ okunur.

senses.label: injury
senses.definitionEn: an injury to the body, especially a cut or hole in the skin

examples.en: The wound on his arm took weeks to heal.
The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.
The soldier had a wound in his leg.

senses.label: injured
senses.definitionEn: hurt by a weapon or in an attack

examples.en: Two people were wounded in the attack.
The wounded were taken to the nearest hospital.
A wounded bird was lying on the path.

grammarNoteTr: wrap something in something: bir şeyi bir şeye sarmak

senses.label: cover with paper or cloth
senses.definitionEn: to cover something by putting paper or cloth around it

examples.en: I need to wrap this present before the party.
examples.tr: Partiden önce bu hediyeyi paketlemem gerekiyor.

examples.en: She wrapped the baby in a soft blanket.
Could you wrap it as a gift, please?

senses.label: packaging
senses.definitionEn: a piece of paper or plastic that covers food or a product when you buy it

examples.en: Please put your sweet wrappers in the bin.
He tore the wrapper off the chocolate bar.
The wrapper says the bread contains nuts.

senses.label: joint between hand and arm
senses.definitionEn: the part of the body between the hand and the arm

examples.en: She broke her wrist when she fell on the ice.
He wears a silver watch on his left wrist.
examples.tr: Sol bileğinde gümüş bir saat takıyor.

examples.en: Typing all day can hurt your wrists.
examples.tr: Bütün gün yazı yazmak bileklerinizi ağrıtabilir.

senses.label: person who writes
senses.definitionEn: a person who writes books, stories or articles, especially as a job

examples.en: My favourite writer lives in a small town by the sea.
examples.tr: En sevdiğim yazar deniz kenarındaki küçük bir kasabada yaşıyor.

examples.en: She wants to become a writer one day.
The magazine is looking for new writers.

senses.label: activity or text
senses.definitionEn: the activity of putting words on paper or a screen, or the words someone has produced

examples.en: Her writing is very hard to read.
examples.tr: Onun el yazısını okumak çok zor.
examples.noteTr: Bağlama göre 'el yazısı' anlamı da verir.

examples.en: Please send us your complaint in writing.
examples.tr: Lütfen şikâyetinizi bize yazılı olarak gönderin.

examples.en: I'm taking a creative writing class this term.
examples.tr: Bu dönem yaratıcı yazarlık dersi alıyorum.

senses.label: in written form
senses.definitionEn: expressed in writing, not spoken

examples.en: We have a written exam and a speaking test.
examples.tr: Bir yazılı sınavımız ve bir konuşma sınavımız var.

examples.en: You need written permission from your parents.
The letter was written by hand.

commonMistakesTr: 'Haksızsın' için 'You are wrong' denir; 'You are not right' daha az doğaldır.
grammarNoteTr: What's wrong (with you)?: Ne oldu, sorun ne?

senses.label: not correct
senses.definitionEn: not correct or true

examples.en: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
Two of my answers were wrong.
We took the wrong bus and got lost.

senses.label: problem
senses.definitionEn: causing a problem or not as it should be

examples.en: What's wrong? You look upset.
Something is wrong with the printer again.

grammarNoteTr: Geçmiş ortaçtan önce 'wrongly' kullanılır: wrongly accused. Fiilden sonra 'wrong' da olur: spell it wrong.

senses.label: incorrectly or unfairly
senses.definitionEn: in a way that is not correct or not fair

examples.en: My name was wrongly spelled on the certificate.
He was wrongly accused of taking the money.
Many people wrongly believe that bats are blind.
examples.tr: Pek çok insan yanlışlıkla yarasaların kör olduğuna inanır.

grammarNoteTr: ABD'de 'yard' evin bahçesi; İng.'de genelde beton avlu.

senses.label: area next to a building
senses.definitionEn: an area of land next to a house or building, often with a hard surface or grass

examples.en: The kids are playing in the back yard.
The school yard was empty during the holidays.
We had a barbecue in our neighbours' yard.

senses.label: unit of length
senses.definitionEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to about 91 centimetres

examples.en: The ball landed about twenty yards away.
examples.tr: Top yaklaşık yirmi yarda öteye düştü.

examples.en: The hotel is just a few yards from the beach.
examples.tr: Otel sahile sadece birkaç adım uzaklıkta.

grammarNoteTr: Günlük konuşmada 'yes' yerine kullanılır; resmî yazıda kullanılmaz.

senses.label: yes (informal)
senses.definitionEn: an informal way of saying yes

examples.en: Yeah, I'll be there at seven.
Do you want some coffee? Yeah, please.
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
examples.tr: Evet, bu iyi bir fikir gibi görünüyor.

grammarNoteTr: Zarf olarak da: paid yearly (yıllık ödenen)

senses.label: every year
senses.definitionEn: happening once a year or every year

examples.en: The town holds a yearly music festival in June.
examples.tr: Kasaba haziranda yıllık bir müzik festivali düzenliyor.

examples.en: You need a yearly check-up for your car.
The membership fee is paid yearly.

senses.label: shout loudly
senses.definitionEn: to shout something very loudly

examples.en: Please stop yelling at your brother.
Someone yelled for help from the river.
The fans yelled when their team scored.

senses.label: colour
senses.definitionEn: having the colour of lemons or butter

examples.en: She wore a bright yellow dress to the party.
examples.tr: Partiye parlak sarı bir elbise giydi.

examples.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
Do you like the yellow or the blue one?
examples.tr: Sarı olanı mı yoksa maviyi mi seviyorsun?

commonMistakesTr: 'Dün akşam' için 'yesterday night' değil 'last night' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Geçmiş zamanla kullanılır: I went ... yesterday.

senses.label: the day before today
senses.definitionEn: on the day before today

examples.en: I saw your sister at the market yesterday.
Where were you yesterday afternoon?
It didn't rain yesterday, but it's raining now.
examples.tr: Dün yağmur yağmadı ama şimdi yağıyor.

commonMistakesTr: 'Yours' isimden önce kullanılmaz: 'your book' denir; 'This book is yours' olur.
grammarNoteTr: Tek başına kullanılır, arkasından isim gelmez.

senses.label: belonging to you
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something belongs to the person you are talking to

examples.en: Is this black umbrella by the door yours?
examples.tr: Kapının yanındaki bu siyah şemsiye senin mi?

examples.en: My phone is old, but yours is brand new.
examples.tr: Benim telefonum eski ama seninki yepyeni.

examples.en: Is he a friend of yours?

grammarNoteTr: Çoğulu: yourselves; by yourself: tek başına

senses.label: you (reflexive)
senses.definitionEn: used when 'you' is both the subject and the object, or to give emphasis

examples.en: Be careful with that knife, you might cut yourself.
examples.tr: O bıçağa dikkat et, kendini kesebilirsin.

examples.en: Help yourself to anything in the fridge.
Did you paint this picture by yourself?
examples.tr: Bu resmi tek başına mı yaptın?

grammarNoteTr: the youth: gençler (topluluk); a youth: genç bir erkek

senses.label: time of being young / young people
senses.definitionEn: the time of life when someone is young, or young people as a group

examples.en: In his youth he played the guitar in a band.
The town opened a new youth centre.
examples.tr: Kasaba yeni bir gençlik merkezi açtı.

examples.en: The program helps unemployed youth find jobs.
examples.tr: Program işsiz gençlerin iş bulmasına yardım ediyor.

senses.label: the number 0
senses.definitionEn: the number 0; nothing at all

examples.en: It was five degrees below zero this morning.
examples.tr: Bu sabah hava sıfırın altında beş dereceydi.

examples.en: The chance of rain today is almost zero.
Write a zero in the box if you have no children.

senses.label: area
senses.definitionEn: an area with a special purpose or with particular features

examples.en: You can't park here, it's a no-parking zone.
examples.tr: Buraya park edemezsin, burası park yasağı olan bölge.

examples.en: London and Istanbul are in different time zones.
examples.tr: Londra ve İstanbul farklı saat dilimlerinde.

examples.en: Learning a new language takes you out of your comfort zone.
examples.tr: Yeni bir dil öğrenmek seni konfor alanının dışına çıkarır.

senses.label: park with animals
senses.definitionEn: a place where wild animals are kept so people can look at them

examples.en: We took the children to the zoo on Saturday.
The zoo has two young lions.
examples.tr: Hayvanat bahçesinde iki genç aslan var.

examples.en: Is the zoo open on Mondays?
